errors.name: API Session
errors.recovery: If no subcode is present, the login status or access token has expired, been revoked, or is otherwise invalid. Get a new access token. If a subcode is present, see the subcode.

errors.name: API Unknown
errors.recovery: Possibly a temporary issue due to downtime. Wait and retry the operation. If it occurs again, check that you are requesting an existing API.

errors.name: API Service
errors.recovery: Temporary issue due to downtime. Wait and retry the operation.

errors.name: API Method
errors.recovery: Capability or permissions issue. Make sure your app has the necessary capability or permissions to make this call.

errors.name: API Too Many Calls
errors.recovery: Temporary issue due to throttling. Wait and retry the operation, or examine your API request volume.

errors.name: API User Too Many Calls
errors.recovery: Temporary issue due to throttling. Wait and retry the operation, or examine your API request volume.

errors.name: API Permission Denied
errors.recovery: Permission is either not granted or has been removed. Handle the missing permissions.

errors.name: Application limit reached
errors.recovery: Temporary issue due to downtime or throttling. Wait and retry the operation, or examine your API request volume.

errors.name: Duplicate Post
errors.recovery: Duplicate posts cannot be published consecutively. Change the content of the post and try again.

errors.name: Error Posting Link
errors.recovery: There was a problem scraping data from the provided link. Check the URL and try again.

errors.name: API Permission (Multiple values depending on permission)
errors.recovery: Permission is either not granted or has been removed. Handle the missing permissions.

subcodes.name: App Not Installed
subcodes.recovery: The User has not logged into your app. Reauthenticate the User.

subcodes.name: User Checkpointed
subcodes.recovery: The User needs to log in at https://www.facebook.com or https://m.facebook.com to correct an issue.

subcodes.name: Password Changed
subcodes.recovery: On iOS 6 and above, if the person logged in using the OS-integrated flow, direct them to Facebook OS settings on the device to update their password. Otherwise, they must log in to the app again.

subcodes.name: Expired
subcodes.recovery: Login status or access token has expired, been revoked, or is otherwise invalid. Handle expired access tokens.

subcodes.name: Unconfirmed User
subcodes.recovery: The User needs to log in at https://www.facebook.com or https://m.facebook.com to correct an issue.

subcodes.name: Invalid Access Token
subcodes.recovery: Access token has expired, been revoked, or is otherwise invalid. Handle expired access tokens.

subcodes.name: Invalid Session
subcodes.recovery: User associated with the Page access token does not have an appropriate role on the Page.
